item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan holding a thick cardboard sheet between a bulb and a white screen. Light from the bulb is blocked by the cardboard before it reaches the screen.

Which claim about the shadow is correct?

options.A: A dark shadow forms on the screen because the cardboard blocks light from the bulb.
options.B: An object that blocks more light makes a lighter shadow on the screen.
options.C: The cardboard still casts a distinct shadow on the screen when the bulb is switched off.
options.D: Only opaque objects can form shadows; translucent and transparent objects cannot form any shadow.
